title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Where to find Microsoft’s Contact and Support Numbers?
summary: This post explains how to find Microsoft's contact and support phone numbers for Dynamics 365 Business Central, including a dedicated sales line and a comprehensive global phone numbers list organized by country and region.
key_points: Sales representatives are available Monday-Friday from 6 AM to 3 PM PT at 800-642-7676
A global phone numbers list provides country-specific support contacts
Billing support is offered in English during business hours (9 AM-5 PM weekdays) in most countries, with local language support varying by region
Technical support is available 24/7 in English, with some local language options
The same phone numbers apply to other Dynamics products including Dynamics 365, AX, CRM, GP, NAV, and SL

quotes.text: Talk to a representative​: Available M-F 6 AM to 3 PM PT. (800) 642 7676
quotes.why_it_matters: Provides the main contact number for pre-sales questions and direct communication with Microsoft representatives

quotes.text: Technical support is provided in English 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, and in some cases, in local languages as noted.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies that technical support is always available regardless of time zone, making it important for urgent issues
